transport: Versioned repository JSON, feature branches, GitHub PRs and workflow evidence; no deployed agent services

planner.authority: Read only; cannot invent priority or completion

implementer.authority: Explicit authorized code changes; no self-approval or production clinical activation

verifier.authority: Independent re-execution/inspection; role label alone is not independence

researcher.authority: Evidence gathering only; no clinical approval

reviewer.authority: Separate accountable non-contributing reviewer; clinical approval additionally requires designated clinical governance

coordinator.authority: Prepare reviewed PRs, never silently overwrite evidence or bypass failures
